Code derivation: data/wurm_2016_burnout_battery.py melts the .sav columns mdi1_neu..mdi10_neu by name, so the live item code IS the source column name.
note: MAPPING. The item codes are the .sav's own column names, but the .sav carries no variable or value labels for the mdi block, so the code->wording tie is the canonical MDI numbering (mdiN_neu = MDI item N) inferred from the order the paper itself lists the ten symptoms in (Methods and S1 Table: Sadness, Lack of Interest, Lack of Energy, Lack of Self-Confidence, Bad Conscience, Taedium Vitae, Concentration Deficits, Changed Activity, Sleep Disturbances, Changed Appetite) -- hence paper_order, not data_labels. VERIFIED against the data, not assumed: the S1 Table publishes per-item means under those symptom names for four groups, and reconstructing the groups from the .sav reproduces all 30 UA/mild-BO/severe-BO cells to within 0.005 (see verify_wurm_2016_mdi.R). LANGUAGE. Administered in German; the German wording is in neither the deposit nor the paper's S1-S3 supplements, so the fallback applies: English in the base fields, language=German, _translated omitted. TEXT IS VERBATIM from Nielsen et al. Table 2 with one disclosed deviation: the source prints items 8 and 10 as two sub-items joined by '?/ ' and that separator was normalised to ' / '. The source typesets item 6 with a typographic apostrophe (wasn’t); it was normalised to ASCII. instructions is blank because no source consulted prints the form's instruction line. RIGHTS: no quotable restriction found on the MDI; it is documented as free of charge and the wording was taken from an open-access article co-authored by its author. option_text is the six published frequency anchors 0-5, identical for every item.
public_note: The Wurm et al. physicians were surveyed in German, but the German MDI wording is in neither the deposited SPSS file nor the paper's supplements, so the item text shipped here is the canonical English MDI (Nielsen, Oernboel, Bech & Christensen 2019, Table 2) rather than what respondents read. Items mdi8_neu and mdi10_neu are each scored as the higher of two sub-items -- restless vs slowed down, and reduced vs increased appetite -- so their item_text carries both alternatives and a response of 4 does not say which of the two produced it.
